title: Characterize object dispatcher 80036308

source_unit.target_ownership: added func_80036308_36F08 (128 bytes) as matching C; later functions remain GLOBAL_ASM

behavior.function_role: per-node dispatcher; it does not walk the linked list
behavior.input: a0 points to one ObjectFlagNode; null exits without a helper call
behavior.dispatch: loads the byte at node+4 and switches on flags & 0x7F: kind 1 calls 80007C90 then 8000A228; kind 2 calls 8000A5C4; kind 3 calls 8000A394; kind 4 and all other kinds call no helper
behavior.writes: the dispatcher itself does not write node flags or next pointer; direct helper side effects are opaque and not modeled
behavior.callers: nine direct caller sites in asm/usa/36750.s; each ignores the return register
behavior.return_register: null retains entry v0; kind 4/default leaves the loaded flag byte in v0; helper cases leave helper return values; all observed callers ignore v0

coverage: actual production 80036308 helper order and arguments
flag and next-pointer preservation with side-effect-free helper stubs
host_tests.negative_control: changing the production mask from 0x7F to 0xFF is rejected by the actual-dispatch/reference trace comparison
host_tests.limitations: host helper stubs record dispatch only; they do not represent helper semantics, engine behavior, or in-game side effects

candidate_trials.variant: single low-seven-bit switch with ordered helper calls
candidate_trials.hypothesis: Express the ROM-observed per-node dispatch cases directly in C and test in the real object_flags translation unit.
candidate_trials.relocations: All four helper calls resolved in the production source-unit link.

decision.reason: The 128-byte candidate matched exactly at its original VMA in the object_flags source unit, and the fresh complete-ROM and symbol-inventory gates passed.
